answers.answer: 6 years of Rust in production: 3 years on a payments backend (tokio, actix) before Kelp Labs, then 3 years of on-chain Rust. She owns code reviews for the program repo and set up their clippy/deny rules.

Shipped the lending pool and liquidation programs to mainnet in 2024 (Anchor 0.29, then migrated to 0.31), maintains the swap program. Did the upgrade to Token-2022 for the pool vaults last spring, with a feature-flagged migration over 2 weeks.

Kelp Labs is a DEX plus lending protocol, ~$40M TVL at peak. She designed the liquidation thresholds with the risk lead and wrote the interest-rate model in fixed-point math. Handled the oracle staleness incident in March: added a max-age check on Pyth prices.

Wrote the Trident fuzz suite for the lending program (found 2 real bugs: a rounding issue in share minting and a missing signer check). Worked through audits with OtterSec and Neodyme, fixed all findings herself and wrote the response doc.
The whole call was in English, fluent and precise. She writes Kelp's audit responses and presents at their community calls in English.
No, she prefers hybrid. Lives in Warsaw (Mokotów), already goes to Kelp's office twice a week.
Kelp is pivoting to perps and she wants to stay in lending; the credit marketplace is exactly that. Likes the small team and working directly with Hanna.
